newsitem.title: UK: UK's Brunner Mond to float at 150 million stg.
newsitem.headline: UK's Brunner Mond to float at 150 million stg.

text.p: UK alkaline chemicals company Brunner Mond Plc said it is to float on the London Stock Exchange later this month.
A company spokesman said the float would capitalise the company at around 150 million pounds, with around half of this representing new money raised in the offer.
Brunner Mond is the sole maker of soda ash in the UK and the largest producer of soda ash in Africa, the company said in its initial, pathfinder prospectus.
An indicative price range for bookbuilding is due to be announced on September 9.
The offer will close on September 18, with dealings expected to start on September 26.
"The flotation will enable us to take advantage of a number of attractive opportunities for the further development of the group," chief executive David Wertheim said in the prospectus.
"The group is benefiting from growing demand and improving prices for both soda ash and sodium bicarbonate," he added.
Brunner said it raised operating profit in the year ended June 30 1996 by 23 percent to 19.4 million stg on turnover of 138.8 million.
